subject: Chapter 40B Review for 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway
overview: The Medford Community Development Board approved a site plan modification for the Medford Housing Authority and granted a special permit for an accessory dwelling unit. The board also compiled advisory comments for the Zoning Board of Appeals on a proposed 350-unit Chapter 40B development at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: 121 Riverside Avenue Site Plan Modification
items.summary: Approved a site plan modification for the Medford Housing Authority at 121 Riverside Ave to allow a 1,517-square-foot office extension, an emergency generator and transformer enclosure, and clarified lot designations for future development.

items.title: Special Permit for Accessory Dwelling Unit
items.summary: Approved a special permit for the city's first accessory dwelling unit located above a detached garage on Paul Road.

items.title: Chapter 40B Review for 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: Reviewed plans for a proposed 350-unit Chapter 40B residential development at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway and drafted advisory comments for the Zoning Board of Appeals covering building height, open space setbacks, trash management, and public transportation.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and Staff Updates
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the October 26, 2022 meeting and received staff updates regarding the upcoming comprehensive plan draft and board vacancy recruitment.
